Quick price play with options (numbers are illustrative; final to be in Excel):

Option 1 — Peak blocks (recommended for predictability)
- Sell blocks measured in token-minutes. Minimum purchase: 500,000 token-minutes for the promo window.
- Price: $0.0045 per token-minute (list) -> with a 12% pilot discount = $0.00396.
- If unused, blocks roll forward one week (one-time roll).
- Guarantees: During block usage, route to dedicated capacity; if dedicated capacity isn't available due to infra incident, credit ladder applies.

Option 2 — Automatic surge routing + capped surcharge
- Base hosted pricing for usage + surge surcharge up to 30% of monthly invoice for the promo window.
- With pilot commitment (1-month pilot + case study), surcharge cap reduced to 20% and apply a 7% volume discount.

Credit ladder (sample):
- >=99.98%: 0% credit
- 99.95–99.979%: 10% credit on surge billing portion
- 99.9–99.949%: 25% credit on surge billing portion
- <99.9%: 50% credit + option for rollback to on-prem failover plan

Operational notes:
- For the 30-minute P1 ack we need a $3k/month pilot retainer to guarantee 15-minute follow-up SLAs and top-tier on-call rotation during the window. Without the retainer we can provide 30-minute ack but triage timelines may be longer.
- I attached a pricing workbook with modeled impact.

If this looks reasonable, Mina — send the Option 1 and Option 2 bullets to Elena and indicate the retainer requirement for 15-min P1 handling.

Rishi

Elena / Sara — thanks for your patience. Attached is a concise offer that reflects your constraints and our operational guardrails. Summary below: 

Final offer (pilot Nov 27–Dec 26):
- Commitment: 1-month pilot with two packaging options to choose from (both include a time-limited 99.98% availability floor for the pilot window):
  * Option A — Peak Blocks (recommended): 500k token-minutes pre-purchase at $0.00396/token-minute (pilot discounted rate). Unused blocks roll forward one week. During block consumption we route requests to dedicated capacity.
  * Option B — Surge Routing + Capped Surcharge: Base usage + surge surcharge, surcharge cap 20% of monthly invoice for the pilot window (pilot case-study discount applied). 7% volume discount on base usage.
- Credit ladder (applies to surge portion or otherwise-billed overrun): same ladder Rishi proposed (>=99.98%: 0%; 99.95–99.979%: 10%; 99.9–99.949%: 25%; <99.9%: 50% + rollback option).
- P1 handling: We will provide a 30-minute acknowledgement at no additional cost. To guarantee 15-minute follow-ups and dedicated on-call during the window we require a $3,000 pilot retainer (one-time for the month).
- No surprise charges: Option A prevents surprise overrun; Option B has an explicit surcharge cap.
- Legal/ops: time-limited SLA amendment for the pilot (we can include start/end dates and a clause limiting broader SLA changes to executed amendments).

Attachments: FastCart_SLA_final_offer.pdf (offer + amendment language)
